name: Undercurrent
blurb: For two people who want to get closer. Three levels; take turns; you may pass once per level.

howToPlay: Two people. Take turns drawing; the drawer answers first, honestly.
You may pass once per level. Say so out loud.
Finish a level before going deeper. Level three is the point.

cards.text: What do you hold back from telling me?
What do you need from me that you've never asked for?
Tell me about a time I disappointed you and you said nothing.
What do you think I'm afraid you'll find out?
What have you forgiven me for without telling me?
When did you almost walk away from me?
What did knowing me cost you?
What do you need from me that you hate needing?
When have you felt furthest from me while we were together?
When have you wanted me to choose you?
When have I made you uncomfortable without meaning to?
When have you felt closest to me?
Which subject do we both steer around?
When have you wanted more from me than I gave?
Do you think I love you more, or you me?
What do you protect me from?
